entities.summary: Serhiy Leshchenko is a Ukrainian ex-journalist, politician and public figure, Member of Parliament. From 2002 until 2014, Leshchenko worked as a Deputy Editor-in-Chief and as a special correspondent for Ukrainska Pravda online newspaper.
